title: Smart Grid - Daily Billing
description: Batch layer: the authoritative per-household bills in daily_bill, written by the Airflow billing DAG. Pick a simulated day at the top; it defaults to the newest billed day. The time picker is not used: sim_day is a simulated date.

list.name: sim_day
list.label: Simulated day
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT sim_day::text FROM daily_bill ORDER BY 1 DESC
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sim_day::text FROM daily_bill ORDER BY 1 DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)                                     AS "Households billed",
       round(sum(total_consumption_kwh)::numeric, 1) AS "Consumption (kWh)",
       round(sum(total_solar_kwh)::numeric, 1)       AS "Solar (kWh)",
       round(sum(net_kwh)::numeric, 1)               AS "Net billed (kWh)",
       round(sum(subsidy_amount)::numeric, 2)        AS "Subsidy (LKR)",
       round(sum(net_amount)::numeric, 2)            AS "Revenue (LKR)"
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date

panels.title: Consumption vs solar generation by zone (kWh)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT grid_zone,
       round(sum(total_consumption_kwh)::numeric, 2) AS "Consumption",
       round(sum(total_solar_kwh)::numeric, 2)       AS "Solar"
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date
 GROUP BY grid_zone
 ORDER BY grid_zone

panels.title: Zone solar contribution
panels.description: Solar share = solar generated / energy consumed, over the whole simulated day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT grid_zone                                     AS "Zone",
       count(*)                                      AS "Households",
       round(sum(total_consumption_kwh)::numeric, 2) AS "Consumption kWh",
       round(sum(total_solar_kwh)::numeric, 2)       AS "Solar kWh",
       round((100 * sum(total_solar_kwh) / NULLIF(sum(total_consumption_kwh), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Solar share %",
       round(sum(net_amount)::numeric, 2)            AS "Revenue LKR"
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date
 GROUP BY grid_zone
 ORDER BY grid_zone

SELECT household_id, net_amount AS "Bill"
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date
 ORDER BY net_amount DESC
 LIMIT 10

panels.title: Lowest-revenue households (solar offset + subsidy)
panels.description: Where the utility earns least: solar covering most of the household's own use (import-only net metering bills max(used - solar, 0)), and the 10% subsidy on top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT household_id AS "Household",
       grid_zone    AS "Zone",
       round(total_consumption_kwh::numeric, 2) AS "Used kWh",
       round(total_solar_kwh::numeric, 2)       AS "Solar kWh",
       round((100 * total_solar_kwh / NULLIF(total_consumption_kwh, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Solar offset %",
       subsidy_flag   AS "Subsidised",
       subsidy_amount AS "Subsidy LKR",
       net_amount     AS "Bill LKR"
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date
 ORDER BY net_amount ASC
 LIMIT 10

panels.title: Revenue and subsidy by simulated day (last 14 billed days, LKR)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT sim_day::text                        AS "Simulated day",
         round(sum(net_amount)::numeric, 2)     AS "Revenue",
         round(sum(subsidy_amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Subsidy"
    FROM daily_bill
   GROUP BY sim_day
   ORDER BY sim_day DESC
   LIMIT 14
) recent ORDER BY 1

panels.title: All bills - $sim_day
panels.description: The daily consolidated billing report, as stored. The same rows are published as s3://reports/billing_YYYYMMDD.csv. run_id traces each row to the batch run and its logs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT household_id, grid_zone, billing_tier,
       round(total_consumption_kwh::numeric, 3) AS total_consumption_kwh,
       round(total_solar_kwh::numeric, 3)       AS total_solar_kwh,
       round(net_kwh::numeric, 3)               AS net_kwh,
       tariff_rate, subsidy_flag, gross_amount, subsidy_amount, net_amount, run_id
  FROM daily_bill
 WHERE sim_day = '$sim_day'::date
 ORDER BY household_id
